activity_summary: Last, at the Bull, the ostler showed you a bay gelding, sound and a little sour, and you pretended to judge its teeth. You bespoke it from Wednesday the twenty-sixth at twelvepence a day and your own charge of fodder. Nothing was paid down.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Judged the teeth for form's sake, and paid nothing.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am looking at them as if I knew.
